FAQ
How does $GODFATHΣR define itself?
$GODFATHΣR is a deflationary reward token built around discipline, not hype. Its visual world is elegance, masculinity, loyalty, strategy and resolve — expressed through four active burn mechanisms, a standing $SIGMA reward, and public on-chain execution.
What's the narrative?

$GODFATHΣR is the next stage of the $SIGMA mindset. A Sigma stands on his own. A Godfather builds something that lasts.

$SIGMA is discipline, independence and self-mastery. $GODFATHΣR keeps all of that, but adds a new layer: responsibility — for the Family, for what you build, and for the people who stand with you.

It isn't a coin that asks to be trusted. It's a coin that shows its ledger.

The word mafia was born in Sicily long before it became synonymous with organized crime. In the 19th century, it carried ideas of pride, boldness, presence and respect. Over time, the word became tied to secret networks built on loyalty, protection and influence. The Godfather comes from the Italian padrino — originally a godfather, but also a patron: a man who protects, connects, settles disputes and commands respect. That is the spirit behind $GODFATHΣR.

What is $SIGMA?
$SIGMA is the token behind Solana's self-reliant, conviction-driven "sigma" culture — its own community, its own story, built long before $GODFATHΣR existed. Follow $SIGMA on X if you want the full picture. It isn't paired with $GODFATHΣR by accident.
Why $SIGMA?
$SIGMA carries its own story — a self-reliant, conviction-driven community that has stayed through cycles, at a valuation many consider below its cultural weight. $GODFATHΣR takes that discipline and gives it somewhere to belong. And it's mechanical, not just narrative: 3% of every $GODFATHΣR transfer buys $SIGMA on the open market.
How does $GODFATHΣR create $SIGMA buy pressure?
3% of every $GODFATHΣR transfer is used to buy $SIGMA. The purchased $SIGMA is then distributed pro rata to $GODFATHΣR holders. This runs continuously and is independent of the four burn mechanisms.
How does The Oath work?
Burn between 50,000 and 1,000,000 $GODFATHΣR from your own wallet, or send it to the official Godfather Burn Wallet. Submit a transaction link (Solscan or any Solana explorer) in the group chat. Once verified, you receive double your qualifying burn back — between 100,000 and 2,000,000 $GODFATHΣR, from a fixed 200,000,000 $GODFATHΣR pool.
Why is the Oath reward allocation finite?
The 200,000,000 $GODFATHΣR pool is fixed on purpose — it caps total qualifying burns at 100,000,000 $GODFATHΣR (since every burn is matched double) and guarantees the reward is fully funded from day one, for everyone who gets in before it's gone.
How does the Family Burn work?
Every new combined X + Fomo follower all-time-high triggers a 10,000 $GODFATHΣR burn from a dedicated 100,000,000 $GODFATHΣR allocation. It runs automatically as the Family's reach grows.
Why use follower ATH instead of current followers?
All-time-high, not live count, so the mechanism can't be gamed by following and unfollowing to farm repeated burns. Only genuine new growth above the previous peak counts.
How does The Laundry work?
Send $GODFATHΣR to the dev wallet — up to 1,000,000 per wallet, per day — and get 120% of what you sent back in $SIGMA. Of what you send: 50% is converted to $SIGMA, 20% stays in the dev wallet, 20% is burned forever, and 10% moves into liquidity.
Can burns be verified?
Every mechanism burns real tokens on-chain, permanently reducing total supply, with transaction links published in each ledger as they happen.
